args.title: [T-001] Implement the public counting core
args.body:
## Task brief <!-- sdd-forge:task-id=T-001 -->

**Outcome:** immutable public result and `count_text` with SPEC counting/BOM semantics; independent expected values cover empty, whitespace, Unicode, CR/LF/CRLF and trailing terminators.

**Context:** Deliver TextStats according to the authoritative task hierarchy: Phase 1, Milestone 1.1. This is planned work; implementation and verification have not been performed.

**Scope and dependencies:** `textstats/counting.py`, public facade, discoverable test package, counting/API tests and professional docstrings. Depends on: none.

**Acceptance and verification:** focused unittest checks and package-level import, including BOM-only/preserved interior BOM cases. No IO or CLI behavior belongs here.

**Result:** Intended outcome is the accepted task behavior and evidence described above; issue creation does not establish completion.

**Sources:** [TASKS](https://github.com/pchemguy/AgentPlayground/blob/main/docs/dev/TASKS.md), [PLAN](https://github.com/pchemguy/AgentPlayground/blob/main/docs/dev/PLAN.md), [SPEC](https://github.com/pchemguy/AgentPlayground/blob/main/docs/dev/SPEC.md), [layout](https://github.com/pchemguy/AgentPlayground/blob/main/docs/dev/layout.md).

<!-- /sdd-forge:task-id=T-001 -->
